title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) is Delaney Dennis R’s 6th Largest Position
text:
Delaney Dennis R reduced its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 4.4% during the 2nd the company in its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The firm owned 14,996 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 695 shares during the period. Apple makes up approximately 4.0% of Delaney Dennis R’s portfolio, making the stock its 6th biggest position. Delaney Dennis R’s holdings in Apple were worth $2,776,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
